pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   B. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   D. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.

2. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.
   C. Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song.

3. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   B. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.

4. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. Only the costume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

9. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software.
   C. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software.
   D. Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Melody in Major Keys: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Melody in Major Keys.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody in Major Keys.
   C. Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody in Major Keys.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.

12. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.
   B. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Dance Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Western Style Solo Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. B — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. C — Practise Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. D — Red, blue, and yellow

6. D — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Musical Instruments 2.4 Western Musical Instruments 2.5 Contem with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — The speed of the music

8. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

9. D — Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Melody in Major Keys with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Dance Production; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Kenyan Folk Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Western Style Solo Songs; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
